invariants.rationale: Ensures that if a result is returned, it is either null or of the correct type.

invariants.expression: result == style.disabled || result == style.checkedDown || result == style.down || result == style.checkedOver || result == style.over || result == style.checkedFocused || result == style.checked || result == style.focused || result == style.up
invariants.rationale: The return value must be one of the style fields based on the control flow.
Result is only null if style.up is null, since the last return is style.up.

invariants.expression: result == style.up || isDisabled() || isPressed() || isOver() || isChecked() || hasKeyboardFocus()
invariants.rationale: If none of the style-based conditions apply, the result is style.up.
If the button is disabled and style.disabled is not null, then the result is style.disabled.
